changelog:
**Summary:**  
Improved skill loading logic and added guidance for common render failures.

- Updated the skill to always load for Orshot tasks, including simple ones, to prevent common user errors.
- Added a detailed "Common Gotchas" section outlining frequent pitfalls (e.g. correct modifications keys, multi-page handling, template ID types, and video requirements).
- Clarified use cases and explicitly stated when not to use the skill (not for pure AI image generation without Orshot/templates).
- Expanded integration and migration guidance for AI agents, MCP clients, and Bannerbear/Placid/Creatomate alternatives.
- Removed the obsolete skill card file (skill-card.md).
summary: Generate images, PDFs, and videos from templates with Orshot — via the REST API, SDKs (Node/Python/PHP/Ruby), the remote MCP server, or no-code tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable), and wire those renders into a recurring automation. Use whenever the user mentions Orshot, connects Orshot to an AI age
